title: Digital Marketing Officer
description:
Digital Marketing Officer (12-Month Fixed-Term Contract)
Hybrid Working £37,435 - £47,435

About the Role

CPI is seeking an experienced Digital Marketing Officer to join a busy marketing team on a 12-month maternity cover contract.

This is a delivery-focused role for a digital marketing professional who can take ownership of campaigns, drive performance across digital channels, and help deliver increasingly sophisticated go-to-market strategies. The successful candidate will bring strong technical expertise in digital marketing, paid media, marketing automation, and campaign optimisation, while working closely with content, communications, and business development colleagues.
We're open to candidates from a wide range of sectors. Previous experience in science or technology is not essential. What matters most is your ability to develop, execute, optimise, and report on effective digital campaigns and apply modern digital marketing best practices.

What You'll Be Responsible For:

Digital Campaign Delivery
- Plan, coordinate, and execute multi-channel digital marketing campaigns
- Support the development and delivery of go-to-market activities across a range of audiences and sectors
- Optimise campaign performance through testing, analysis, and continuous improvement
- Work with internal stakeholders to maximise engagement, lead generation, and conversion outcomes

Marketing Automation & CRM
- Manage and optimise marketing automation activities
- Develop automated lead nurture campaigns and customer journeys
- Build and maintain campaigns within HubSpot and associated CRM systems
- Support lead generation and conversion programmes through data-driven marketing activity

Paid Media & Social Advertising
- Manage paid advertising campaigns across platforms including:
- LinkedIn
- Google Ads
- Paid Social Media
- Display Advertising
- Conduct audience targeting, campaign optimisation, and performance analysis
- Monitor ROI and recommend improvements to maximise performance

Website, SEO & Conversion Optimisation
- Support website management and landing page optimisation
- Conduct SEO analysis and implement best practice improvements
- Use analytics, audience insights, and testing methodologies to improve user experience and conversion rates
- Support content optimisation across digital channels

Performance Analysis & Reporting
- Analyse campaign performance across digital channels
- Produce reports and actionable insights for stakeholders
- Monitor KPIs, audience behaviour, conversion metrics, and channel performance
- Identify opportunities for growth, optimisation, and automation

About You

You are an experienced digital marketer who understands the fundamentals exceptionally well and knows how to turn strategy into measurable results.

You'll bring:
- Proven experience in digital marketing, ideally within a B2 B environment
- Experience running successful paid social and digital advertising campaigns
- Strong knowledge of:
- Marketing automation
- Email marketing
- CRM platforms such as HubSpot
- Paid media channels
- Website analytics
- SEO best practice
- Strong analytical and reporting skills
- Experience using digital marketing data to optimise campaign performance
- Excellent project management and stakeholder engagement skills

Desirable Experience
- Go-to-market strategy development and execution
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Website and CMS management
- Audience segmentation and targeting
- AI-enabled marketing tools and automation platforms
- Working with agencies and external marketing partners
- Experience within technology, innovation, or complex B2 B organisations

Why Join CPI?
- Opportunity to own and deliver impactful digital campaigns
- Work across a wide range of marketing channels and technologies
- Exposure to evolving marketing automation and go-to-market approaches
- Collaborative and supportive marketing team
- Competitive salary (£37,435 - £47,435)

Location & Working Pattern
- Hybrid working arrangement
- 12-month fixed-term contract (maternity cover)
- Flexible working environment
- Reporting into an experienced marketing leadership team

The Opportunity

This role is ideal for a hands-on digital marketing professional who enjoys campaign delivery, optimising performance, and staying ahead of developments in digital channels and marketing technology. If you're experienced in digital marketing fundamentals, confident using platforms such as HubSpot, and excited by modern go-to-market strategies, we'd love to hear from you.

Guidant, Carbon 60, Lorien & SRG - The Impellam Group Portfolio are acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Marketing Business Partner
description:
Marketing Communications Business Partner
12-month Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Cover) North East England (Sedgefield, Darlington, Wilton) 43,108 - 50,000
About the Role:

CPI is seeking a Marketing Communications Business Partner to join our Marketing team on a 12-month maternity cover, supporting the delivery of campaign-driven marketing activity across our Materials business.
This is a highly varied, delivery-focused role where you will take ownership of multi-channel marketing campaigns, working closely with the Head of Marketing and wider business stakeholders. You will play a central role in executing established marketing plans, managing campaigns, and ensuring strong engagement across both digital and in-person channels.

With autumn being a peak period for events and conferences, this role requires someone who can step in quickly, take ownership, and deliver with minimal supervision in a fast-paced environment.

Hybrid working is supported, with travel required across CPI sites and events.

What You'll Be Responsible For:
Campaign Delivery & Execution
- Lead the delivery of integrated marketing campaigns aligned to business objectives
- Execute campaign activity across digital, inbound and outbound channels, including:
- Website content
- Social media
- Email and automation
- Work closely with content and communications teams to develop campaign assets
- Monitor performance and optimise campaigns through KPI tracking and reporting

Events & External Engagement
- Lead the planning and delivery of events, conferences, and exhibitions
- Develop event plans, agendas, and supporting materials in collaboration with internal teams
- Maximise commercial opportunities from events, including lead generation and follow-up strategies
- Support delivery of webinars and hosted events across CPI facilities

Stakeholder & Business Partnering
- Act as the Marketing Business Partner for the Materials side of the business
- Work closely with senior stakeholders to align campaigns with commercial objectives
- Provide best practice advice and guidance on marketing activity across teams

Project Management & Coordination
- Manage multiple campaigns and activities simultaneously across the marketing calendar
- Coordinate timelines, stakeholders, and outputs across a busy programme of work
- Ensure consistent delivery against agreed plans and deadlines

Strategy Contribution
- Support the development of future campaign strategy toward the latter part of the contract
- Provide insights and recommendations based on campaign performance and market trends

About You:

You are an experienced marketing professional who enjoys working autonomously, delivering campaigns end-to-end, and engaging with stakeholders across a complex organisation.

You'll bring:
- Strong experience in B2 B marketing, ideally in a campaign-driven role
- Proven ability to manage and deliver multi-channel marketing campaigns
- Experience planning and delivering events, conferences, or exhibitions
- Strong project management and organisational skills
- Confidence working with stakeholders and operating independently

Desirable (but not essential):
- Experience working in technical, scientific, or sustainability-focused environments
- Familiarity with digital marketing tools, analytics, and automation platforms
- Experience working within matrix organisations or multi-site environments

This role requires someone who is:
- Able to manage competing priorities and deliver at pace
- Strong in both execution and relationship-building

Why Join CPI?
- Work within a highly regarded and supportive marketing team
- Deliver impactful campaigns across sustainability-driven materials programmes
- High level of responsibility and ownership
- Exposure to both digital campaigns and high-profile industry events
- Competitive salary 43,108 - 50,000

Location & Working Pattern
- Hybrid working (typically 2 days per week on-site)
- Travel required for events and conferences (UK-based)
- Full UK driving licence and access to a car required

The Opportunity

This is an excellent opportunity to step into a highly visible marketing role within a busy, well-established team - delivering real commercial impact while gaining exposure to multi-channel campaigns, events, and stakeholder-led marketing.

Guidant, Carbon 60, Lorien & SRG - The Impellam Group Portfolio are acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We're working with an established, growing digital agency in the North East that is looking for an ambitious and hands-on Marketing Manager.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced digital marketer who is ready to take the next step in their agency career, combining hands-on digital marketing with client strategy, account ownership and team development.

You'll play a central role in driving performance across a portfolio of client accounts while supporting and mentoring a growing marketing team.

The role would suit a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist or existing Marketing Manager with strong technical expertise who wants greater ownership of strategy and the opportunity to develop their leadership and commercial skills.

You'll work closely with senior leadership and have a clear progression route towards taking greater ownership of the marketing department.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Support & Leadership
- Act as a day-to-day point of support for a team of marketing specialists, content executives and apprentices.
- Mentor team members, share technical knowledge and help maintain consistently high standards across client delivery.
- Support the coordination of project timelines, workloads and team capacity.
- Work closely with senior leadership to continue developing your management and leadership capabilities.

Client Strategy & Account Management
- Take ownership of key client relationships and act as a strategic point of contact.
- Translate performance data into clear insights and recommendations.
- Lead regular client review calls and meetings.
- Develop joined-up digital marketing strategies across SEO, paid media, content and social media.
- Support proposals, pitches and digital strategies for prospective clients.

Hands-on Digital Marketing
- Remain hands-on with campaign delivery and optimisation across your core area of expertise, whether that's SEO, PPC, Content or Social Media.
- Provide SEO, UX and strategic input into website rebuilds, migrations and landing page projects.
- Work collaboratively with design and development teams.
- Monitor and report on performance using tools including GA4, Google Search Console and Looker Studio.
- Identify opportunities to improve performance and drive further growth across client accounts.

Key Requirements:
- Digital marketing experience, ideally gained within a fast-paced agency environment managing multiple client accounts.
- Strong practical knowledge across digital marketing disciplines including SEO, PPC, Content and/or Social Media, with deeper expertise in at least one area.
- Experience using data and analytics to measure performance and campaign ROI.
- Knowledge of tools including GA4 and Looker Studio.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills.
- Confidence building and maintaining relationships with client stakeholders.
- A degree in Marketing, Business or a related subject, or equivalent practical industry experience.
- A genuine ambition to progress into a broader leadership position.

Desirable Experience
- Previous team management, mentoring or project management experience.
- Experience supporting website migrations, re-platforming or launches.
- Knowledge of WordPress, Shopify or similar CMS platforms.
- Experience creating custom Looker Studio dashboards.

For more information, apply now!

title: Social Media Manager
description:
We're working with a highly successful, fast-growing business within the beauty sector, with an established presence across both the UK and international markets.

They are looking for someone with previous experience working within the beauty or hair industry, alongside proven experience managing and developing a social media team. You'll understand the market, its audiences and the type of content that resonates within the sector, while being confident leading a team and driving the overall social strategy.

Operating across both consumer and professional audiences, the business has built a strong reputation for premium products, exceptional quality and ethical sourcing. With an ambitious growth strategy and an expanding team, this is an exciting opportunity to join the business at a key stage of its development.

This role can be remote, with occasional travel to their office in the North East.

The Role

We're looking for an experienced Social Media Manager to lead the organic social media strategy across two established hair and beauty brands.

This is a social-first, brand-led role with a particular focus on growing brand authority, engagement and community across both professional and consumer audiences.

You'll take ownership of the overall social strategy while managing and developing a team of two Social Media Executives responsible for day-to-day execution.

A key part of the role will be building and nurturing the brand's professional hairdresser and stylist community, creating engaging social-first content and developing meaningful relationships with industry professionals and brand advocates.

Key Responsibilities:

Social Media Strategy & Direction
- Define and own the organic social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube and emerging platforms.
- Establish clear objectives, content pillars and platform strategies aligned with wider brand and growth goals.
- Oversee weekly and monthly content planning to ensure consistency, quality and strategic alignment.
- Collaborate with brand, digital and education teams to ensure social activity supports wider campaigns and business initiatives.

Content Leadership & Storytelling
- Lead the strategic direction of social content across in-house creation, stylists, educators and community-led storytelling.
- Brief and provide creative direction for social-first content shoots, campaigns and activations.
- Establish and maintain standards for visual identity, tone of voice and storytelling across organic social channels.
- Ensure content is created with repurposing in mind, supporting paid social, CRM and web activity where appropriate.
- Support the development of founder, educator and spokesperson content in line with wider brand positioning and thought leadership.

Leadership & Team Management
- Line manage and develop two Social Media Executives.
- Set clear expectations, priorities and objectives across the team.
- Provide ongoing coaching, guidance and feedback to support professional development and consistently high-quality output.
- Establish clear ownership across strategy, leadership and execution to create an efficient and effective social function.

Community, Performance & Reporting
- Develop the approach to community engagement and brand voice across social channels.
- Oversee sentiment monitoring and community insights, identifying advocates, creators and UGC opportunities.
- Own social and community reporting, tracking KPIs across brand growth, engagement and community participation.
- Use performance insights to continually refine content and social strategy.

Stakeholder Collaboration
- Report into the senior Brand & Marketing leadership team and work closely with departments across the business.
- Collaborate with senior stakeholders on social, content and storytelling initiatives.
- Act as a key internal expert for social media and community activity, providing strategic direction and leadership across the business.

Requirements:
- Proven experience within a Social Media, Community or Brand-focused role, ideally within hair, beauty, cosmetics, fashion or a similar consumer-led industry.
- Previous people-management experience, including coaching and developing direct reports.
- Demonstrable experience owning organic social strategy across platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube.
- A track record of delivering social growth, engagement and measurable brand impact.
- A strong understanding of brand-led, social-first storytelling and the ability to translate brand positioning into engaging and culturally relevant content.
- Experience working with professional, trade or industry communities.
- Experience developing engaged communities, professional networks or brand advocacy programmes.
- The ability to brief, direct and oversee content creation including shoots, campaigns and social activations.

For more information, apply now!
